chunks: A man is praying while a woman is parallel to him or at his side, so he said: If her prostration is aligned with his bowing, then there is no harm.
6—From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام.
He said: I asked him about a woman praying near a man, so he said: A woman should not pray directly in line with a man unless he is in front of her, even if only by the measure of his chest.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman in the legal ruling being discussed
key_terms.بِحِذَائِهِ: parallel to him or directly beside him
key_terms.بِحِيَالِ: directly facing or in line with

ai.seo_question: Can a woman perform salat (prayer) beside or directly in line with a man?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling of a woman praying beside or in line with a man during salat (prayer). It indicates a legal distinction regarding their relative positioning, while also mentioning a circumstance in which there is no problem.
